program: L5 is the strategy; pairing, rebates, residual caps and sports selection are implementation/economic considerations, not replacements for his behavior; any safety override is recorded as OUR deviation from L5; a hard catastrophic-loss shell around the account, maximum L5 fidelity inside it.

taker_share.labels: maker/taker known only inside takerOnly feed coverage; unknown never treated as maker

l5.labels: DERIVED from L5's executed fills on the public feed; a fill is not a quote

ours.labels: R4 order records: rest_s is submit-to-terminal; a reprice is our own cancel when the touch moved

maker_rest_30s.class: (b) execution policy set by the owner for sports books, NOT a venue requirement: Polymarket US accepts immediate cancel/replace (post-only orders cancelled after 1-2 s of rest all day without rejection); L5's own cadence on BTC/ETH 5m books is ~2 s

complete_fee_safe_bound.class: (a) owner risk/fee rule (OWNER DECISION 5533476555): safety_override, kept explicit

live_bindings.labels: deduplicated by decision_id across every saved session_end row; shells as persisted

shell.labels: hard shell; nothing inside it is a strategy rule

removals.name: Completion pair-cost ceiling
removals.ours: COMPLETE only at pair <= 1.00 (fee-safe bound price)
removals.blocks: COMPLETE at L5's touch when the pair would exceed 1.00
removals.l5_does: pair unit cost at completion p50 0.9876, p75 1.0151, p90 1.0553; 0.3723 of his completions above 1.00, 0.2209 above 1.02, 0.1127 above 1.05
removals.removal: price the complement at L5's touch (deficit-side touch join), whatever the pair; the loss on an above-par pair is (pair - 1) x matched shares and is bounded by the per-market cap
removals.worst_case_note: DERIVED: at L5's p90 pair 1.0553 on the whole per-market cap the above-par cost is this many dollars; the shell already bounds it
removals.recommend: REMOVE in R5 (record pair > 1.00 as L5-consistent, not as a deviation)

removals.name: Per-market unmatched-dollar cap
removals.l5_does: residual per window p50 $18.5701, p90 $121.159 on spend p50 $92.9151 (residual/spend p50 0.1999); 0.9836 of his EXTENDs would be refused by a 1-action-unit cap
removals.removal: remove the separate unmatched cap; the per-market cap ($7.5) is the only inventory bound, exactly as L5's residual is bounded only by what he committed
removals.worst_case_note: already the per-market cap; no new dollars at risk

removals.name: Maker rest floor before cancel/replace
removals.ours: 30 s rest, then cancel; reprice cadence >= 30 s
removals.class: (b) owner execution policy, not a venue requirement
removals.blocks: L5's 2-6 s reprice; fills after 20 s are 22% of ours
removals.l5_does: multi-print cluster duration p50 2 s, p90 15 s; clusters longer than our 30 s deadline 0.0389
removals.removal: reprice at the model's own reevaluation cadence (2 s / 30 s per state) with cancel/replace; class (b): an owner execution policy, not a venue requirement
removals.worst_case_note: no new dollars at risk; more cancel/replace messages

removals.blocks: L5 works 2+ windows 51% of his active time (median 2)
removals.l5_does: median 2 simultaneous windows, 0.507929 of active time at 2+, max 4

bound_live.note: every candidate cycle while a residual was held was skipped (CAMPAIGN_HOLD:POSITION_HELD)

bound_live.R4: campaign stops at 3 settled; the 6 h horizon stopped it once at 14:48Z

removals.name: Entry price band
removals.where: OWNER DECISION 5533476555: observation 0.35-0.65 (spring_watch prefilter + entry_band gate)
removals.ours: enter only with YES bid in 0.35-0.65
removals.blocks: L5 states outside the band (p<25c, p>65c) which the model already covers
removals.l5_does: share of L5 fills priced inside 0.35-0.65: 0.2909
removals.removal: widen entry to every state the frozen model covers with evidence (the off-distribution hold still protects unknown states); size unchanged so the worst case is unchanged. This is the largest fidelity gap by share of his activity (71% of his fills are outside the band)
removals.recommend: STAGE (R5b) after the band-inside sample is compared out of sample

removals.name: Maker-only (post-only), taker disabled
removals.where: executor post_only=True everywhere; live_policy 'maker/post-only only; taker disabled'
removals.blocks: L5's taker actions (2-3% of actions by state, 15% of fills overall)
removals.l5_does: taker share of known-side fills 0.1659; model p_taker 2-3% of actions by tte bucket
removals.removal: allow taker only when the model's p_taker draw says so for that state (2-3% of actions); fee 0.06 x p(1-p) per share, bounded by the per-market cap
removals.worst_case_note: DERIVED: max taker fee if every share of the per-market cap were taken at p=0.5
removals.recommend: STAGE (R5b) after the fee is measured on the first taker fills

removals.name: Off-distribution hold
removals.where: frozen model: state not in the canonical history -> hold
removals.ours: hold when the (state, relation) key is unknown
removals.blocks: acting where we have no L5 evidence; a fidelity protection, not a deviation
removals.removal: none; fidelity protection. Shrinks as the versioned lookup refreshes from his newest activity

removals.name: Per-action size / size cap
removals.blocks: L5's size (p50 12.5 shares); size_divergence=venue_minimum_vs_l5_target on every row
removals.l5_does: shares per fill p25/p50/p75 5.0/12.5/40.0; dollars per fill p50 $4.5
removals.removal: keep the action size where it is; size scales with the bankroll after profitability is measured (owner: profitability tells how far to scale, not how to rewrite)

r5_rung.deviation_recording: every live decision keeps would_act_without_safety_cap, divergence_class and counterfactual_l5_price; under R5 a pair above 1.00 at L5's touch is L5-consistent (no deviation); the per-market cap and the daily stop are the only deviations and are labelled shell_cap
r5_rung.stop: daily loss stop, the 7-day horizon, or the owner; no cohort stop; report per settlement
r5_rung.labels: PROPOSAL derived from the audit; not an approval; nothing mutates until the owner writes the rung id
